components.name: Chip
components.description: A pill for a tag or a filter; a tint colors it, selected fills it.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line, #d9ded6); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 700 13px/1.3 'Zen Maru Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--tint, var(--muted, #4b5563)); transition: background-color .28s ease, color .28s ease, border-color .28s ease; } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--tint, var(--ink, #1c2238)); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c2238); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button on a sheet (Create, Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink, #1c2238); color: #fff; font: 700 13px/1.3 'Zen Maru Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1c2238); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Write Button
components.description: The red stamp at the bottom right of the canvas that starts a note.
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 58px; height: 58px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--red, #d7263d); color: #fff; font: 700 24px/1 'Zen Maru Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(215, 38, 61, .35); }

components.name: Sticky Note
components.description: An idea on the desk: paper stock, navy ink, the author's dot.
components.html:
鼎泰豊で小籠包

components.css: .ds-note { position: relative; width: 164px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff1b8); color: #1c2238; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(28, 34, 56, .14); transform: rotate(-1.5deg); font-family: 'Zen Maru Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-note-t { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-note-b { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: #4b5563; } .ds-note-tags { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; gap: 2px 8px; } .ds-note-who { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--who, #9aa09c); }

components.description: A different stock for a member's (often the agent's) suggestion, with adopt and dismiss.
components.html:
Claudesuggestion

components.css: .ds-sug { width: 186px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #faf9f5; color: #141413; border: 1px solid #e3dacc; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(28, 34, 56, .14); font-family: 'Zen Maru Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sug-h { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-sug-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--who); } .ds-sug-h small { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; color: #73726c; } .ds-sug-t { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-sug-act { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-sug-act button { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 12px/1 inherit; background: none; } .ds-sug-ok { background: var(--who); color: #fff; } .ds-sug-no { border: .5px solid rgba(31, 30, 29, .3); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Three equal tabs; the current one is Stamp Red over a soft red highlight.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button aria-current="page">キャンバス</button><button>地図</button><button>しおり</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-top: 1.5px solid var(--line, #d9ded6); font-family: 'Zen Maru Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: none; color: #4b5563; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tabs button[aria-current] { color: #d7263d; background: color-mix(in srgb, #d7263d 12%, #fff); }

narrative.overview: The screen is a desk: a soft green-gray surface with the faint dot grid of graph paper, and on it, paper. Ideas are sticky notes in pastel paper colors, scattered at slight angles, each with a small colored dot saying whose hand it came from. Everything that is not paper is a tool left on the desk. Tools are drawn with thin ruled lines and sit flat; paper lifts. The voice is warm and paper-like.
keyCharacteristics: A desk, not a page: a dotted surface you pan and pinch, with paper on it
Paper colors are the only saturated fills; chrome is white, line and navy
One accent, stamp red, spent on the few things that start an action
Pills for tools, soft small radii for paper, soft offset shadows only on what lifts
Rounded Japanese-first typography in a fixed pixel scale, never fluid

rules.name: The Paper Stays Light Rule
rules.body: A note's background is one of the six stocks and is never themed; the desk and the tools change with the theme, the paper on them does not.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp Red appears where an action begins (the write button, the current tab) or where something is destroyed. Never as a border, a heading color or a decoration.

rules.name: The Whose-Hand Rule
rules.body: A member's color says "by whom" and nothing else: the dot on a card, the dot by a suggestion, the tint of a tag chip. It never fills a surface that is not about that member.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes are the pixel steps in tokens.css (11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 22). No clamp(), no viewport units; this is a tool viewed at arm's length on a phone.

rules.name: The Weight Carries It Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from 400 / 700 / 900 in one family. A second family, uppercase tracking or gradient text is not in the vocabulary.

rules.name: The Ink Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are Pen Navy at low alpha, offset downward with a soft blur. Never black, never a zero-offset halo, never a hard block.

rules.name: The Lift Means Pick-Up Rule
rules.body: Dragging raises the shadow and nothing else; the card does not scale or glow.

dos: Do keep paper light in both themes and write on it in Pen Navy.
Do spend Stamp Red on at most one or two things per screen: the thing that starts, the thing that destroys.
Do give a member's color exactly one meaning: whose.
Do make tools pills and panels with a 1.5px Ruled Line, or a solid Pen Navy fill, never both.
Do keep every size on the fixed pixel scale and every transition at 280–350ms with --ease-morph.
Do cast shadows in Pen Navy at low alpha, offset down, when something lifts; lift chips, switches and sheets gently in the same vocabulary.
donts: Don't add a second typeface, uppercase tracking, gradient text or an eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't theme a sticky's background or draw it with a hard offset shadow.
Don't use a member color as a surface, border or heading color outside of "by whom".
Don't fill the canvas with same-size cards in a grid; stickies keep their scatter and their tilt.
Don't reach for a modal; the app's sheets are full-screen and everything else is inline or a floating menu.
